title: Beyond reweighting: On the predictive role of covariate shift in effect generalization
authors: Ying Jin; Naoki Egami; Dominik Rothenhäusler
one_line_what_it_does: Empirical rule that standardized covariate shift bounds standardized conditional shift across 680 studies/65 sites; justification via random dense distribution shift model (Thm 3.3 distributional CLT) and prediction intervals for generalization
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Part 2 (the rule being conditioned); no counterexample or neutrality condition found in the text read

title: Out-of-distribution generalization under random, dense distributional shifts
authors: Yujin Jeong; Dominik Rothenhäusler
one_line_what_it_does: Random-perturbation model for multiple distributions; optimal weighted ERM and OOD risk expressions under random dense shift
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Part 2 (model behind Jin et al.) and part 3 (random shifts across groups); theory sections not read

title: Learning under random distributional shifts
authors: Kirk Bansak; Elisabeth Paulson; Dominik Rothenhäusler
one_line_what_it_does: Random shift model with arbitrary covariate shift plus dense random shocks to Y|X; compares standard/proxy/hybrid prediction strategies by MSE
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Model structure of covariate shift + random conditional shock; targets prediction not label-free performance estimation

title: Transporting a prediction model for use in a new target population
authors: Jon A. Steingrimsson and 2 other authors (per arXiv listing)
one_line_what_it_does: Identification and estimation of target-population MSE etc. from source labels plus target covariates under conditional transportability; prediction error modifiers
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Part 1 (covariate-explained part of risk by density ratio/outcome regression): taken

title: Robust Estimation of Loss-Based Measures of Model Performance under Covariate Shift
authors: Samantha Morrison; Constantine Gatsonis; Issa J. Dahabreh; Bing Li; Jon A. Steingrimsson
one_line_what_it_does: Doubly robust / data-adaptive estimators of target risk under covariate shift with only target covariates; large-sample theory
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Part 1 (density-ratio + outcome-regression estimators of covariate-explained risk): taken

title: Sensitivity analysis for studies transporting prediction models
authors: Jon A. Steingrimsson; Sarah E. Robertson; Issa J. Dahabreh
one_line_what_it_does: Exponential-tilt sensitivity model for violation of Y independent of population given X; identification of target risk as function of tilt parameter and estimators
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Part 1 (what is identified/sensitivity when conditional transportability fails); not a location-scale block, no minimax bound

title: Leveraging Unlabeled Data to Predict Out-of-Distribution Performance
authors: authors not shown in retrieved results (Garg et al.)

bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Part 1 (generic identification/impossibility): taken in general form

title: Estimating Model Performance Under Covariate Shift Without Labels (PAPE)
authors: Jakub Bialek et al.

bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Part 1 (label-free covariate-shift estimator)

bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Part 1 (structured non-covariate shift made identifiable); different structure from location/scale block

title: The Label Complexity of Class-Conditional Coverage under Distribution Shift
